records.jp: もう？　もうって、何が？
records.en_original: Already? What do you mean, already?
records.en: Already? What do you mean, already?

records.jp: あれが！？　あんなのと戦うの！？
records.en_original: And we have to fight it!?
records.en_auxiliary: And we have to fight it?!
records.en: That thing!? We're supposed to fight that!?

records.jp: よかった。日菜子たちは無事だったんだね
records.en_original: Good, I'm glad you're all safe.
records.en_auxiliary: Good, I'm glad you're all safe.
records.en: Thank goodness. I'm glad you and the others are safe.

records.jp: 大変なの！　あのね、あの……
わかってる。アイツのことだよね
それだけじゃないの！　私たち以外、<CR>みんな動かなくなっちゃったの！
records.en_original: That's not all! We're the only ones who can move right now!
records.en_auxiliary: That's not all! We're the only ones who can move right now!
records.en: That's not all! Everyone except us<CR>has stopped moving!

records.jp: わからない。けど、あの化け物が急に現れたと思ったら、<CR>他のみんなが動かなくなってて……
records.en_original: I dunno why, but as soon as that monster appeared, everyone else just...stopped moving.
records.en_auxiliary: I dunno why, but as soon as that monster appeared, everyone else just stopped moving.
records.en: I don't know why. But when that monster suddenly appeared,<CR>everyone else stopped moving...

records.jp: ここに来るまでに、西田さん以外は誰も動いてなかったよ
records.en_original: I didn't see anybody moving on my way here, except for Nishida.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't see anybody moving on my way here, except for Nishida.
records.en: I didn't see anybody moving on my way here, except for Nishida-san.

records.jp: 大丈夫だよ。みんなは時間が止まってるだけ
records.en_original: It's okay. Time has stopped for her, just like it has for everyone else.
records.en_auxiliary: It's okay. Time has stopped for her, just like it has for everyone else.
records.en: It's okay. Everyone's time has just stopped.

records.jp: 原種がもうここまで来たからね。<CR>今はコモンにいるのと同じような状態
records.en_original: Due to the Sephira's proximity to us, right now, it's as if we're in the Common.
records.en_auxiliary: Due to the Sephira's proximity to us, right now, it's as if we're in the Common.
records.en: The Sephira has come this close.<CR>Right now, the real world is in a state similar to the Common.

records.en_original: Then why can these two still move?
records.en_auxiliary: Then why can these two still move?
records.en: Then why can these two still move?

records.jp: 指輪をしてるから。それで、リフレクターの力が流れ込んで<CR>コモンの力を共有してるから
records.en_original: Because of their rings. The rings channel our power as Reflectors, and let them share the power of the Common.
records.en_auxiliary: Because of their rings. The rings channel our power as Reflectors, and let them share the power of the Common.
records.en: Because they're wearing rings.<CR>Reflector power flows through them, letting them share the Common's power.

records.jp: だからこうして指輪をつければ
records.en_original: So, if we put a ring on Sarasa...
records.en_auxiliary: So, if we put a ring on Sarasa...
records.en: So, if we put a ring on Sarasa...

records.jp: みんなお願い！　あいつを倒せるのはユズたちだけなの。<CR>力を貸して！
records.en_original: Everyone, please! We're the only ones who can defeat that thing. Lend us your strength!
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone, please! We're the only ones who can defeat that thing. Lend us your strength!
records.en: Everyone, please! We're the only ones who can defeat it.<CR>Lend us your strength!

records.jp: あれと戦う？　そんなの無理だよ……
records.en_original: YOU'RE going to fight THAT? That's impossible...
records.en_auxiliary: You're going to fight that thing? That's impossible...

records.jp: 大丈夫。そのための力はある！
records.en_original: Trust me. We have the power!
records.en_auxiliary: Trust me. We have the power!
records.en: It's okay. We have the power to do it!

records.jp: なんで、現実でも変身できるの？
records.en_original: Wait, how did you transform outside the Common?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, how did you transform outside of the Common?
records.en: Wait, how did you transform outside the Common?

records.jp: 原種が来たから、現実でもエーテルの、リフレクターの力を<CR>使えるようになってるの
records.en_original: Thanks to the presence of the Sephira, we can use the power of Ether -- of the Reflectors -- even in the real world.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks to the presence of the Sephira, we can use the power of Ether—of the Reflectors—even in the real world.
records.en: Thanks to the Sephira's presence, we can use Ether--the power of Reflectors--<CR>even in the real world.

records.jp: このままじゃみんなアイツにやられて死んじゃう。<CR>お願い！　力を貸して！！
records.en_original: If we don't do this, it's going to kill everyone. Please! Lend us your strength!!
records.en_auxiliary: If we don't do this, it's going to kill everyone. Please! Lend us your strength!!
records.en: If we don't do this, it'll kill everyone.<CR>Please! Lend us your strength!!

records.en_original: H-How are we supposed to do that?
records.en_auxiliary: H-how are we supposed to do that?
records.en: H-How are we supposed to do that?

records.jp: その指輪にはみんなの、想いの力が詰まってる。<CR>それを使えば一部だけどその力が使えるの
records.en_original: Those rings contain the power of all of your feelings. By using them, we can combine our strength!
records.en_auxiliary: Those rings contain the power of all of your feelings. By using them, we can combine our strength!
records.en: Those rings are filled with the power of all your feelings.<CR>If you use them, you can wield some of that power.

records.jp: うん。お願い、ユズたちを助けて
わかった。どのみち、ここで戦わないと死んじゃうんだし。<CR>やってみるよ
records.en_original: I know. If we don't stand our ground here, we'll all die anyway. I'd rather go out fighting.
records.en_auxiliary: I know. If we don't stand our ground here, we'll all die anyway. I'd rather go out fighting.
records.en: Okay. Either way, if we don't fight here, we'll die.<CR>I'll try.

records.jp: ありがとう！　それじゃあグラウンドで迎撃しよう！
records.en_original: Thank you! Let's try to intercept it out on the field!
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you! Let's try to intercept it out on the sports field!
records.en: Thank you! Let's try to intercept it out on the field!
